payload.description:
# Agent copy-edit loop

## Intent

As a copy-editing agent, I want to scan, record explicit finding decisions, generate patch options, rank those options with compare, and present a shortlist to a human — so I improve text without becoming a silent editor or an auto-publisher.

## Done when

- Agent (or human) records `skip` / `rewrite` / `delete` / `keep` / `add` against finding ids. Scan does not invent those decisions.
- `limatus options` still generates 2–3 patches only for `rewrite` findings; no whole-document `revised_text`.
- Agent may run compare on those option texts (or on original vs a trial apply) before consulting a human.
- Working draft changes only when an apply is recorded. External publish is out of this tool.
- Provenance retains scan output, decisions, options, compare ranking, model/prompt versions.

## Out of scope

Newsroom UI. Fine-tuned preference model. Non-OpenAI option generation (existing OpenAI options path stays).
